_doc: The run-proof binding contract (#1608), the ONE source for every engine. The input role `operating_status` (history column operating_status, 0/1 or a 0-1 fraction; run when > threshold) says whether the equipment a rule judges is proven running at a sample. It is resolved from the model, never from point names: tier 1 = the equipment's own proof (status roles first, then command roles, in the order below); tier 2 = the proof of the equipment that feeds it (refs listed under `feeders`, in order, first feeder with proof wins; RDF: brick:isFedBy / brick:feeds); otherwise NONE, and a gated rule is SKIPPED with reason no_run_proof (never a silent PASS). Read by scripts/nf/sync_pypi_data.py (open_fdd/data/run_proof.json), open_fdd/run_proof.py and nf-app/static/run-proof.js.

alignment.unknown: no proof sample at or before the sample within max_age, or a NULL proof: cannot create a fault, never energized
alignment.note: #1631: a sample's proof is the latest proof sample of the same equipment at or before it, no older than MAX_GAP_HOURS (runtime_defaults.json). An exact-timestamp join is the zero-age special case (fail-closed).
